title: Understanding becomes an explicit mechanism
why: The controls were more concrete than the way fragmented conversations become business meaning.
mechanism: Contextual retrieval, typed observations, competing interpretations, scoped identity resolution and versioned episode membership. Episodes group evidence and records; they do not own truth.
test: Two crates short → remaining came → photo → other outlet → revised invoice. Retract the wrong relationship, reopen the shortage and retain history.

title: Normal work gets a quiet path
why: An exception-only assistant would miss most daily work and turn the app into an alarm panel.
mechanism: Process ordinary receipts, counts and bills alongside exceptions. Quiet extraction is not silent acceptance: admission still follows the agreed business policy.
test: A normal complete delivery is correctly reflected without a false discrepancy or unnecessary clarification.

title: Owner commands and voice notes arrive early
why: The original product promise includes speaking or typing useful work, not only asking questions.
mechanism: Typed intent with scope, authority, progress and outcome; voice-note transcription with critical-number and negation checks. Consequential effects use the applicable preview/review.
test: Prepare a pending report, assign a follow-up and correct a quantity through the app. Duplicate submissions create one logical request.

title: Documents become versioned outputs
why: A PDF can remain in circulation after its source quantity or status changes.
mechanism: Record template version, input record versions, file hash, audience and supersession. Keep historical files and label their freshness; sharing is a separate authorized action.
test: Correct a quantity after generating the PDF. Mark the tracked report stale/superseded and generate a new version. Do not pretend downloaded copies can be recalled.

title: Choose the acknowledgement channel
why: We promised assigned work and acknowledgement without choosing how staff receive it while outbound WhatsApp stays deferred.
mechanism: Trial an enrolled manager on the responsive GoFathom app early. Optional enrolled staff see scoped tasks. Manual relay is labelled and counted; external sends need the appropriate gateway.
test: A manager receives and accepts a specific task version. A message view or manual relay is not automatically acknowledgement.

title: Authentication includes recovery and departure
why: Permission checks alone do not cover expired connections, shared phones, staff leaving or orphaned assignments.
mechanism: Enrollment, scoped grants, connector recovery ownership, device revocation and authorized task reassignment. Recheck current access on pending effects.
test: Revoke a manager while a review is open; reconnect a source without broadening access; leave an assignment pending authorized reassignment.

title: Phone and desktop share one durable state
why: The assistant must continue across devices and survive intermittent connectivity.
mechanism: Responsive first surface, durable request IDs, version checks and queued/synced/conflicted states. Full native installers and ambient capture remain later.
test: Start on phone, continue on desktop, reconnect an offline device after access is revoked. No duplicate or stale privileged action.

title: Memory must change when evidence changes
why: Remembering more is not useful if corrections leave stale tasks, answers or PDFs behind.
mechanism: Track consequential derivations, including model interpretations, plus scoped queries and watermarks for absence claims. Invalidate affected results; revalidate tasks and approvals.
test: A late credit note invalidates a prior no-credit-note result. A correction reaches a closed episode even without an exact reply or document number.

title: Budget exhaustion is a visible product state
why: Affordability was a formula without a clear user experience when capacity runs out.
mechanism: Per-tenant budgets, bounded retrieval/retries, queue age and operational recovery. Do not silently drop work or route every overflow to the owner.
test: Exhaust the configured processing budget. Pending work and its consequences stay visible; recovery is deduplicated and policy-qualified.

title: Put safeguards and demand evidence before expansion
why: Late security tests or late buyer feedback can invalidate an otherwise polished build.
mechanism: Isolation tests before real data, plain source/group transparency, a named buyer/reviewer and price hypothesis. Early acknowledgement trial and protected fresh cases.
test: Deny cross-business retrieval and revoked access before intake. Record actual reviewer effort and demand evidence rather than assumed willingness to pay.

title: Keep Ramya in the foundation tests
why: A restaurant-only implementation could embed assumptions that make matter confidentiality and notice revisions expensive later.
mechanism: Small synthetic or consented legal identity, permission and revision fixtures. Full Gmail/matter operations follow separate domain qualification.
test: Two matters for one client remain separated; a revised notice changes the right matter only. No inferred statutory deadline.

title: Keep the core; earn each expansion
why: A new framework or more services does not repair wrong identities, dropped instructions or stale conclusions.
mechanism: Retain useful TS/Postgres code after inspection. Use modules, isolated parsers and a bounded runner. Preserve the external authority for stock/accounting fields.
test: Replay the same real app path and source-pinned defects. Replace a component only when a measured gap and comparison justify it.
